Single source only; confidence Medium.

summary: Qulliq Energy Corporation (QEC), Nunavut's territorial power utility, reported that its corporate office in Iqaluit was broken into during a string of break-ins in the city between mid-December 2025 and early January 2026. Thieves stole 800 pages of paper customer records with billing information used for pre-authorized payments, including customers' names and mailing addresses; no electronic records were taken. The break-in was reported to the RCMP.
